title: Bluegate Business Storage Account Application Review and Approval Standard
content:
An application for a Bluegate Business Storage Account is decided against the requirements of the program applied for. The standard applied at review is as follows.

## The standard

1. **Documents.** An application needs the documents the program lists as required to open the account.
2. **Credit review.** Where the program requires a credit review at application, the application needs a passed credit review.
3. **Active agreements.** The business must hold at least the program's required number of active agreements on approval. The count is taken from the company's agreement records for the applying business profile at the date the application is handled, and is the number of that business's storage unit rental agreements and Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreements whose status is active, delinquent or moving out.
4. **Approval.** An application that passes review is approved and the account opens. An approval sets the program's credit limit and the program's invoice terms on the account.
5. **Decline.** An application that falls short is declined, and the business keeps its agreements on standard billing.

The application is in review until it is either approved (the account becomes active) or declined.

## What counts toward the agreement requirement

| Agreement held by the applying business | Counts |
|---|---|
| Storage unit rental agreement, status active | Yes |
| Storage unit rental agreement, status delinquent | Yes |
| Storage unit rental agreement, status moving out | Yes |
| Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement, status active, delinquent or moving out | Yes |
| Any agreement in another status | No |
| An agreement held by a different customer profile | No |

## Decision table

| Required documents supplied | Credit review (where the program requires one) | Agreements counted on the handling date reach the program's figure | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Passed, or not required | Yes | Approved; the account opens with the program's credit limit and invoice terms |
| No | any | any | Declined; agreements stay on standard billing |
| any | Required and not passed | any | Declined; agreements stay on standard billing |
| any | any | No | Declined; agreements stay on standard billing |

## Worked count (hypothetical)

*Hypothetical business and program:* a program requiring 2 active agreements. On the handling date the business holds one storage unit agreement that is delinquent, one storage unit agreement whose tenancy has ended, and one parking agreement that is moving out. The delinquent unit and the moving-out parking agreement count; the ended agreement does not. The count is 2, which reaches the 2 required, so this requirement is met. If the parking agreement had also ended before the handling date, the count would be 1 and the application would fall short.
